micro_topic: Judiciary > Art 128 retired judges; HC power of review
core_fact: Art 128: CJI, with the previous consent of the President, may request a retired SC judge (or a qualified retired HC judge) to sit and act as SC judge. HCs, as courts of record (Art 215), have inherent power to review their own judgments, though only the SC has an express review power (Art 137).

statements.label: ii
statements.text: A High Court has the power to review its own judgment as the Supreme Court does, although no specific power of review is conferred on it by the Constitution.

phrases.meaning_here: inherent power of a court of record

reconstruction.why: Art 128 + inherent review power of HCs.
reconstruction.micro_topic_rule: SC review = Art 137 (express); HC review = inherent (court of record, Art 215). Ad hoc judges = Art 127; retired judges = Art 128.
